patches.name: Clone app (Sobosuba)
patches.description: Sobosuba-targeted patch: changes the app package name to allow installing the same app multiple times. By default ".morphe" is appended to the package name. Each cloned install must use a unique package name. Cloning does not work with all apps and using this patch may cause app crashes or other unexpected behavior.

options.description: Package name to use for the cloned app.
Update custom permissions declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts, but can break features in certain apps.
Update provider names declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts, but can break features in certain apps.

patches.name: Enable debug mode (Sobosuba)
patches.description: Makes Sobosuba debuggable, allowing mod installation via Shizuku without root.
